release_notes:
v0.2.0 — Enterprise Orchestrator + Enhanced Business Workflows

NEW: Enterprise Orchestrator capability for cross-department coordination
  - HR, Compliance, Policy Review, Operations, Analytics, Executive Brief
  - Company Confidential classification with executive approval gates
  - Audit trail references in all outputs

ENHANCED: Business Workflow with 10 sub-workflows
  - Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Operations, HR Draft
  - SOP, Checklist, Support Draft, Handoff, Automation Plan
  - Auto-detection of sub-workflow from chat messages
  - Department selector in dialog
  - Runtime integration with sub-workflow-specific prompts

NEW: Update Checker — automatic notification when new versions are available

IMPROVED: Intent classification — better separation of Enterprise vs Business
  - Enterprise = cross-department, executive-level, company confidential
  - Business = single-department, manager-level approval
